description: SINOE ® - Flux de collecte - Indicateurs de synthèse is published by ADEME. The synthesis table reports collected waste tonnage, population and collection ratios by actor and waste type. Its stated coverage is France; reporting actors, years and administrative areas. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The inspected page does not state a reusable licence. Ratios require the matching population and collection-category definitions. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
